AiFinding.description: A law note the server kept (LC-9b): its verdict recomputed, its clause filled in.
AiFinding.title: AiFinding

AnswerRequest.description: A person's answer to an issue; `undo` takes it back and needs nothing else.
AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

AppliesTo.description:
What a rule checks, in the drawing model's words (room types as MarkView.room_type,
element classes as the drawing model's). Room ops: the rooms of `room_types`, but not one
whose printed label is one of `skip_labels` (a dining nook typed living). door_width:
`element_classes` ["door"], only the doors that meet a room of `room_types` (every door when
empty) and none of `not_room_types`. A takeoff rule may name types or classes (for the
screen).
AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo

ChatInfo.description: The project chat agent (decision 0013): CHAT_MODEL, and whether a turn can run now.
ChatInfo.title: ChatInfo

ChatTurn.description: A turn as the API returns it: `answers` typed as POST /api/projects/{id}/ask's answers.
ChatTurn.title: ChatTurn

Check.description: The double-check request on an answer that is not certified.
Check.title: Check

CheckMark.description:
An item a result is about, drawn on its page. subject: the room or door checked; counted:
what was counted for it (a room's windows).
CheckMark.title: CheckMark

CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Clause.description: Where a limit comes from: the clause someone read, the page it is on, and its sentence.
Clause.title: Clause

ClauseView.description: A clause with what citing it needs from its law.
ClauseView.title: ClauseView

ConflictValue.description: answer_v1.1: one of the values two methods measured for the answer, with its evidence.
ConflictValue.title: ConflictValue

Description.description:
Step 2, for a file that is not a floor plan: what the picture shows, as a fixed form and
a long text (decision 0010 section 8). `text` is the short form a file row shows; `detail`
the long one kept for later AI use. Nothing tested depends on `detail`.
Description.title: Description

DescriptionView.description: The file's description as the tools show it (its cost left out).
DescriptionView.title: DescriptionView

Disputed.description: One place to double-check, as the answer gives it.
Disputed.title: Disputed

DrawingEntry.description: One drawing of a project: one per group of renderings of the same plan.
DrawingEntry.title: DrawingEntry

Edit.description: One review edit (POST /drawings/{id}/review). `reset` without a quantity resets them all.
Edit.title: Edit

ErrorBody.description: Every error: one sentence, a code, and FastAPI's list for a request that fails validation.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

EvidenceDetail.description: `register` is a pydantic model attribute, so the field is `register_` under `register`.
EvidenceDetail.title: EvidenceDetail

FileEvidence.description:
FileStatus.evidence: whether a file that is not a floor plan is in the project's evidence
index, and from what (decision 0012 sources v2). Written by the evidence step for every file it
looked at; a file today's triage path set aside and described keeps its record in `triage`.
FileEvidence.title: FileEvidence

Finding.description:
One rule on one room or door whose result the proposal changes, or that still fails on a
room or door it touches (LC-3). `ev`: the chat's evidence id, set by the agent loop.
Finding.title: Finding

Highlight.description:
One element the 3D view highlights, by its IFC GlobalId, and what happens to it: an
answer's counted elements are `affected`; an edit proposal's are moved, removed or added.
Highlight.title: Highlight

IssueLinks.description: API paths to open the issue; None where there is nothing to open.
IssueLinks.title: IssueLinks

Item.description: A removed or added piece of geometry (a wall strip, a door, a new partition).
Item.title: Item

Limit.description: A number a drawing could be checked against: "habitable room area >= 7 m2".
Limit.title: Limit

MarkView.description:
One mark as the screen draws it. `n`: its number on the drawing, None when not counted.
`value`: its share of the quantity (1 in a count, the room's m2 in an area), None: unknown.
`label`: the room's printed label, else the element class; `ref`: the element or room id in
the drawing model; both None when the mark is no item of the model (an added mark).
MarkView.title: MarkView

Model3d.description:
FileStatus.model_3d (MODEL_3D setting): the 3D view of an IFC file, a GLB converted once
on its first request (GET .../files/{file_id}/model.glb) or ahead by `python -m app.cli glb`.
Model3d.title: Model3d

Normalised.description:
How an image was brought into the frame every page size, box and served page is in:
EXIF orientation applied, then any turn, deskew or perspective correction. The pipeline
reads the normalised image, never the upload's bytes.
Normalised.title: Normalised

Overrule.description: A person's call on a file's relevance; the judge's own verdict stays as it was.
Overrule.title: Overrule

ProjectView.description: Ingest's project status, plus the project's drawings, one per plan.
ProjectView.title: ProjectView

QuantityConflict.description:
Stage 10: the drawing's conflict entry (stage 8) about one quantity of the takeoff, in
that quantity's unit: every method's value, and the rule that picked one (None: no rule
decides). `derived`: how the values were carried over from another entry, when they were.
QuantityConflict.title: QuantityConflict

ReadAsPlan.description: A person's call that a file triage set aside is a floor plan: it was read as one.
ReadAsPlan.title: ReadAsPlan

Reader.description: How a drawing was read: its route, the file it was read from and that route's reader.
Reader.title: Reader

Refusal.description: Why a question gets no number, for a person, with questions this drawing can answer.
Refusal.title: Refusal

Register.description:
Triage.register: what the classifier read off an image sheet, floor plans included. The
triage class is derived from it (`class_of`); the rest is shown, never acted on in this
version (a plan's scale_shown is not compared with what its reader found).
Register.title: Register

Relevance.description: Step 3, once the project's plans are read: does the described file belong to it.
Relevance.title: Relevance

RelevanceRequest.description:
A person's call on a triaged file's relevance (decision 0010). `by` as a sign-off's;
`undo` takes the call back and, like unsettle, needs nothing else.
RelevanceRequest.title: RelevanceRequest

Resolved.description:
What the resolver (RESOLVER, app/core/review/resolve.py) said about a conflict or an answer
that is not certified: a value it picked, or that it can't tell, why, and where it looked.
Checked by a model: never a person's settle or sign-off, never certified.
Resolved.title: Resolved

Resolving.description:
POST /api/projects/{id}/resolve: the review after the resolver's replies, and a note for
each conflict it gave no reply on (the budget used up, a timeout...).
Resolving.title: Resolving

Row.description: One quantity of the takeoff with its review state.
Row.title: Row

RuleCheck.description:
One rule on one drawing: fail when a result fails, else cannot tell when one is, else
pass. With no results: cannot tell when the drawing could not be checked (what the rule needs
was not read), not_applicable when it has nothing the rule applies to.
RuleCheck.title: RuleCheck

RulePackView.description:
A pack as GET /api/info lists it, for the country picker: the flag from `country`, the
country's name, the pack's name and law line, and every rule with the clause it quotes.
RulePackView.title: RulePackView

RuleView.description:
A rule as the pack states it. `op` is the machine check type, never shown; `comparison`
is machine (">="), `comparison_text` the words the screen shows ("at least").
RuleView.title: RuleView

ScaleView.description: The sheet's scale as read. `ratio`: N of a printed "1:N", None when the text is no ratio.
ScaleView.title: ScaleView

Scope.description: The filters of a takeoff key, parsed, so the screen can group rows without parsing keys.
Scope.title: Scope

SecondCount.description: What the second method did on a drawing: quantities it measured and where it disagreed.
SecondCount.title: SecondCount

Selection.description: What the user pointed at on a plan: a room (`ref` its id) or a dragged rectangle (`box`).
Selection.title: Selection

ServiceAction.description:
One consequence of the edit in one discipline. `label` is the whole of it in plain words,
numbers included; the rest is for drawing it.
ServiceAction.title: ServiceAction

ServiceMark.description:
One service element near the edit, for the overlay: a run as its line, anything else as
its point. Page fractions.
ServiceMark.title: ServiceMark

Settled.description: The value a surveyor chose to keep for a quantity (the `settle` action).
Settled.title: Settled

Sheet.description:
Classified.sheet and Triage.sheet: the sheet-kind model's reply and its decision. The
title, sheet number and printed scale are shown, never acted on.
Sheet.title: Sheet

Signal.description:
A raw score a reader gives an answer, named for what it is. Not a probability that the
answer is right: `calibrated` says whether it was checked against right answers (never yet).
Signal.title: Signal

Skipped.description: A file ingest set aside, with the reason.
Skipped.title: Skipped

Suggestion.description: A question the parser is checked to map to `quantity`, so asking it is never refused.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

TocEntry.description: One line of a pack's table of contents: what exists, for the prompt and the screen.
TocEntry.title: TocEntry

Triage.description:
FileStatus.triage: what triage made of an image file (decision 0010). Build a changed one
with `model_validate`, not `model_copy`, so `verdict` follows `overruled` and `relevance`.
Triage.title: Triage

TriageRequest.description:
A person's call that a file triage set aside is a floor plan (decision 0010): it is read
as one. `by` as a sign-off's.
TriageRequest.title: TriageRequest

ValueMark.description: Where one item a conflicting value counted or measured is on the drawing, named.
ValueMark.title: ValueMark

View.description: The plan the turn wants on screen: one drawing page, its marks, the box to focus.
View.title: View

ViewMark.description: One place on the plan the turn shows (.agents/chat/contract.md A).
ViewMark.title: ViewMark

app__core__agent__model__Level.description: An answer's confidence level as ask_drawings gives it (ADR 0011 'confidence levels').
app__core__agent__model__Level.title: Level

app__core__review__check__Level.description:
How far to trust an answer: one of three levels, what it rests on, and one plain sentence
with the measured counts behind it.
app__core__review__check__Level.title: Level

The synthetic sample archive. `fresh`: the review edits of the last sample run are reset.

`models_3d`: the 3D views' state to put on IFC parts at response time (MODEL_3D); the chat
tool calls this without, so a kept chat never keeps a stale state.

get.description:
Up to `k` files, best first, one hit each with its best-matching passage. Files judged
unrelated are searched only with `include_unrelated`.

One passage (`f7-detail-2`) or a file as a whole (`f7`, its summary), with the file's
description, register and relevance.

post.description:
A photo added to a finished project from the chat (board #203). The body is the image's
bytes, png or jpeg; `name` its file name. It is read in the background, alone, while the
project stays done. Returns the new file, queued; poll the project. 404 unknown project,
409 until the project is done or while a file of it is read, 413 over the upload limit, 415
not a png or jpeg.

get.description:
An IFC file's 3D view: one GLB of the whole model, each node named by its element's
GlobalId. The first request starts its conversion (409 `converting` until it is built; poll
it or the project's `model_3d`); gzipped when the client takes gzip.

404.description: no such file, no IFC file, or MODEL_3D off

409.description: code converting: being built, ask again

422.description: code too_big, no_geometry or failed: no view

get.description: The file as uploaded, EXIF turn applied only: an image, or a PDF's first page.

post.description:
A person says whether a file triage set aside belongs to the project, or takes that back
(`undo`; with no call made, nothing changes). The file stays set aside either way: a call
is no reading. Any file triage called not a floor plan takes a call, described and judged
or not. 409 until the project is done; 422 `not-triaged` for a file triage did not set
aside as not a floor plan.

A person has a file triage set aside read as a floor plan: it is read in the background,
alone, while the project stays done. Returns the file, queued; poll the project. 409 until
the project is done or while a file of it is read again; 422 `not-triaged` for a file triage
did not set aside as not a floor plan. A sheet the sheet-kind step doubted (flagged) was read
already: its flag is dropped at once, nothing is read again. No undo: a reading is not
unread.

post.description:
RESOLVER: a model looks at each conflict no rule decides and no person settled, and picks
a value or says it can't tell; one call per conflict, replies kept with the project's review,
so a second POST asks only about what changed. 409 when RESOLVER is off or before `done`.
It also runs on its own when an upload's ingest is done (`_resolve_when_done`).

get.description: Per drawing what is left to review and what is signed, and every conflict of the project.
Every file's trace in one request, in the order the upload lists the files.
